senses.gloss: f. (תָּפַל; v. תִּפְלָה) frivolity, trivialness; obscenity.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:5:8">Y. Taan. IV, 68ᵈ</cite> top, v. <cite ref="B00784"><he>בְּכִיָּה</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 2:1:4">Y. Snh. II, 20ᵃ</cite> top; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 3:8:3">Y. M. Kat. III, 83ᵈ</cite> top <he>קרע של ת׳</he> a wanton rent in a garment (without any religious significance); Bab.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 4:20">Num. R. s. 4<sup>20</sup></cite> <he>כל העם … ובנו עונה דברים של ת׳</he> all the people said Halleluiah after the reader, and his son spoke some frivolous words.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 4:20">Ib.</cite> s. 10<sup>3</sup> <he>עובדי … בדברי ת׳</he> when the gentiles eat and drink, they engage in indecent talk.

<cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 2:20">Ruth R. to I, 14</cite>; <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 5:10">Ex. R. s. 5</cite>, a. e. <he>כל נשיקות של ת׳ הן וכ׳</he> all kissing is of a frivolous nature, except the kiss of homage &c., v. <cite ref="N01317"><he>נְשִׁיקָה</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 3:4">Sot. III, 4</cite> <he>כל המלמד … מלמדה ת׳</he> he who teaches his daughter the Law, is like teaching her obscenity (because the laws concerning sexual aberrations may excite her sensuality).

<cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 3:4">Ib.</cite> <he>רוצה אשה בקב ות׳ וכ׳</he> a woman prefers a Kab (scanty living) connected with license, to nine Kabs with the restrictions of chastity; <cite ref="Ketubot 62b">Keth. 62ᵇ</cite>; a. fr.
